caption: Bob's read on the payroll file sits in four processes, P1 P4 P9 and P12. Deleting bob's entry or one shared handle costs 1 step; back-pointers or four private handles cost 4.

spec.title: Payroll ACL, bob's copies, revoke steps
spec.aria: The payroll access list is raj read-write, bob read, group hr read, root read-write; bob's read has four copies in P1, P4, P9, P12, and revoking costs 1 step by access list, 4 by back-pointers, 1 by shared handle, 4 by private handles.
